# LaBaNi

LaBaNi is the official ticketing page for the Last Born Association Party at Kintik Resort in Nigeria.

## Primary Page

- `/`: LaBaNi event booking app for standard entry tickets, resort activity selection, group guest tickets, payment details and Don of Last Borns VIP access.

## Key Facts

- Event name: LaBaNi Last Born Association Party
- Venue: Kintik Resort, Nigeria
- Base entry ticket: NGN 50,000 per guest
- VIP package: Don of Last Borns, NGN 500,000
- VIP capacity: 10 slots
- Activities: Nightclub, Pool Side, Playhouse, Train Ride, Lounge, Karaoke Sit-out / Restaurant and Concert
- Payment bank: Stanbic IBTC
- Payment account number: 5770807090
- Payment account name: LaBaNi

## Crawl Notes

The page includes Schema.org JSON-LD structured data for the organization, website, event, offers, resort activities and FAQs.
